leads.claim: The U.S. government has conducted secret UAP crash retrieval programs designed to identify and reverse engineer alien craft.
leads.why: A former government official explicitly confirms the existence of crash retrieval and reverse engineering programs under oath.
leads.claimant: Luis Elizondo, former Director of National Programs Special Management Staff
leads.government_response: The witness confirms the existence of these programs under oath.
leads.quote: Were they designed to identify and reverse engineer alien craft? Yes or no? Mr. ELIZONDO. Yes.

leads.claim: The U.S. government is in possession of nonhuman biological bodies.
leads.why: The witness provides a direct affirmative response to a specific question regarding the possession of bodies.
leads.claimant: Luis Elizondo, former Director of National Programs Special Management Staff
leads.government_response: The witness confirms the possession of bodies under oath.
leads.quote: But was anything described as that we have possession of bodies? Mr. ELIZONDO. Yes. Yes, sir.

leads.claim: Biologics have been recovered in relation to UAP phenomena.
leads.why: The witness confirms awareness of reporting regarding the recovery of biologics, though he notes his own focus was on physical craft.
leads.claimant: Luis Elizondo, former Director of National Programs Special Management Staff
leads.government_response: The witness acknowledges the reporting of recovered biologics.
leads.quote: I am, sir, aware of the reporting that biologics have been recovered.

doc_verdict: This document contains sworn testimony from a former government official asserting that the U.S. government has conducted secret programs to recover and reverse engineer UAP craft and possesses nonhuman biological bodies.
